verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents API reference pages for the Raw Event Export, Query, and Feature Flags APIs. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, such as a try-it console. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so no machine-readable spec backs an explorable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
